# Proper Facilities Management

> National commercial cleaning, janitorial, and facilities management partner for multi-location restaurant and retail brands.

Proper Facilities Management provides recurring commercial cleaning and janitorial services — daily porter staffing, floor care (carpet, concrete, stone, tile, wood), window and glass cleaning, pressure washing and softwashing, and construction/turnover cleanup — as its core, flagship service. Proper also provides additional facilities services on the same account: general maintenance and repairs, plumbing, pest control, HVAC and refrigeration, electrical and lighting, signage maintenance, and 24/7 emergency response.

Proper serves multi-location restaurant chains (fast-casual, quick-service, full-service dining) and multi-location retail chains (specialty apparel and general retail) across the United States, dispatching through a vetted national network of cleaning crews, day porters, and technicians, with each account managed by a single dedicated account manager as one point of contact across every location.

Proper does not publish location counts, pricing, or client names publicly at this time; pricing is scoped per proposal based on number of locations, service scope, and frequency.
